title: What I received looks like it was made from a different species of pine or something....
text:
What I received looks like it was made from a different species of pine or something..... The wreath I received looks like it was made from sprigs of a fake pine Christmas tree. The one shown in the listing shows smaller pieces and they're much rounder and bushier looking. The wreath is pretty and smells amazing but I honestly wouldn't pay more than about $25 for what I received. It does arrive kind of flat and you do have to fluff it out yourself- it makes all the difference! But even after some fluffing, it just doesn't look like the photo really. It looks like a 2nd hand company attempted to make one to look like it.

I didn't know much about wreath care so I did a search to find out they make wreath spray which is kind of overpriced so I went with the alternative method and sprayed it with hairspray after having soaked it overnight- completely submerged in water to hydrate it. After soaking it- the pine smell became INSANELY strong and filled the house! I drip dried it by hanging it on the showerhead.

Overall this was a fun experience- I've never had a live wreath! I now can say I've done it but I personally won't be spending $50 for anything like this myself.
